title: Linux - Main System Information (formerly Main System Information)
html:
Main System Information

Inspect the host's kernel, filesystem, privileged helpers, and available escape routes before choosing a local escalation technique. The privilege escalation checklist gives a compact order of operations.

  • Kernel vulnerability assessment and runtime exposure checks build applicability, reachability, and active mitigations.
  • Kernel modules and modprobe abuse covers module loading and helper-path exposure.
  • Sudo command abuse examines ways delegated commands can cross privilege boundaries.
  • Symlinks, hardlinks, and file descriptors covers path redirection and inherited or deleted-open files.
  • Filesystem, inodes and recovery explains filesystem behavior useful during investigation.
  • Checklist: Linux privilege escalation lists host checks and links to deeper material.
  • Escaping from jails covers limited shells and constrained environments.
  • Kernel/LPE/CVE material groups focused local privilege escalation and vulnerability write-ups.
